rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the Joint Sitting of 14 June 2005 (members assembled at 14:02; the sitting rose at 14:19) the President of the Republic, printed by title only ('The PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC'; this Hansard does not print his name), said he had come to the conclusion that 'it would be best to release hon Jacob Zuma from his responsibilities as Deputy President of the Republic and member of the Cabinet', and that he would in due course announce the changes in the executive to take account of 'the void that the departure of Deputy President Jacob Zuma has created'.

bounded_scope: Deputy President observations for CLAUDE-C01-21 only (role za_deputy_president in za_presidency). Announcements, stated intentions, appointments and their notices, oaths and their scheduling, stated assumptions, releases, resignations and their stated effect, Assembly-seat events and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder observations and any start or end are decided in the packet, not by any row. The President's roles (za_president_election, za_state_president) and the ANC's party office are excluded and no row feeds them.
